question: Driving eight hours a day at 60 km/h, how many years would it take to drive every road in the United States?
explainer: The US has about 6.7 million km of public roads. At 480 km a day that is 14,000 days, about 38 years.

question: If every car in the world were parked bumper to bumper, how many times would the line wrap around the equator?
explainer: There are about 1.5 billion cars, each about 4.5 m long: 6.75 billion metres, 6.75 million km. The equator is 40,075 km, so about 170 times round.

question: Driving non-stop at 100 km/h, how many days would it take to drive once around the equator?
explainer: 40,075 km at 100 km/h is about 401 hours, which is about 17 days of driving.

question: How many full days a year does the average American driver spend behind the wheel?
explainer: Americans drive about 13,500 miles a year, 21,700 km. At an average 50 km/h that is 434 hours, about 18 full days a year.

question: How many Titanics would fit inside Icon of the Seas, the world's largest cruise ship, by gross tonnage?
source_title: Icon of the Seas vs Titanic (Cruise Hive)
explainer: Icon of the Seas measures 250,800 gross tons; the Titanic measured 46,328. That is about 5.4 Titanics.

question: How many bathtubs of jet fuel does a Boeing 747 burn on a 10-hour flight?
source_title: How much fuel does a jumbo jet burn? (Flight Deck Friend)
explainer: A 747 burns about 11 tonnes an hour, so 110 tonnes in 10 hours. Jet fuel weighs 0.8 kg a litre, so that is 137,000 litres: about 460 bathtubs.

question: How many London buses parked end to end would it take to stretch across the English Channel at its narrowest?
explainer: The Strait of Dover is 33.3 km wide and a New Routemaster is 11.2 m long, so about 3,000 buses.

question: How many flights take off somewhere in the world every minute?
source_title: How many aeroplanes head for the skies each day (Air Dolomiti)
explainer: About 100,000 commercial flights take off every day. Divided by 1,440 minutes that is about 69 a minute, more than one a second.

question: How many passengers pass through Atlanta's airport, the world's busiest, every minute?
explainer: Hartsfield-Jackson handled 108.1 million passengers in 2024. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 210 passengers a minute, day and night.

question: How many Eiffel Towers' worth of metal is there in the Golden Gate Bridge?
explainer: The Golden Gate Bridge contains about 83,000 US tons of steel, 75,000 tonnes. The Eiffel Tower's iron weighs 7,300 tonnes, so about 10 Eiffel Towers.

question: How many bicycles would it take to weigh the same as an empty Boeing 747?
explainer: An empty 747 weighs about 180 tonnes, 180,000 kg. A bicycle weighs about 12 kg, so about 15,000 bikes.

question: Over a 60-year driving life, how many whole years does the average American spend driving?
explainer: About 434 hours a year behind the wheel, times 60 years, is 26,000 hours: about 3 years of your life in the driver's seat.

question: How many shipping containers does the Port of Shanghai, the world's busiest, handle every minute?
explainer: Shanghai handled 51.5 million standard containers in 2024. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 98 containers a minute.

question: On average, how many seconds pass between one aircraft movement and the next at London Heathrow?
explainer: Heathrow handles about 475,000 take-offs and landings a year, about 1,300 a day. 86,400 seconds divided by 1,300 is one every 66 seconds or so.

question: How many trips around the equator is a car's typical 300,000 km lifetime?
explainer: A well-kept car covers about 300,000 km before it is scrapped. The equator is 40,075 km, so about seven and a half laps of the planet.

question: Flying non-stop at 900 km/h, how many days would it take to fly once around the equator?
explainer: 40,075 km at 900 km/h is 44.5 hours, which is about 1.9 days in the air.

question: How many cars are built around the world every minute?
explainer: About 93.5 million motor vehicles were produced in 2023. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 180 vehicles a minute.

question: How many New York City subway rides begin every second?
explainer: The subway carried about 1.15 billion riders in 2023. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 36 rides starting every second.

question: Cycling eight hours a day at 20 km/h, how many days would it take to ride around the equator?
explainer: 40,075 km at 160 km a day is about 250 days of pedalling.

question: How many airline passengers board a flight somewhere in the world every second?
source_title: The World of Air Transport in 2023 (ICAO)
explainer: Airlines carried about 4.3 billion passengers in 2023. Divided by 31.6 million seconds, that is about 140 boardings a second.

question: How many Eiffel Towers stacked on top of each other would reach a cruising airliner?
explainer: Jets cruise at about 11,000 m and the Eiffel Tower is 330 m tall, so about 33 towers.

question: How many round trips to the Moon do all the miles Americans drive in a year add up to?
explainer: Americans drove about 3.26 trillion miles in 2023, 5.2 trillion km. A round trip to the Moon is 768,800 km, so about 6.8 million round trips.

question: How many Uber rides start every second around the world?
source_title: Uber announces results for fourth quarter and full year 2023 (Uber)
explainer: Uber averaged about 26 million trips a day in 2023. Divided by 86,400 seconds, that is about 300 rides a second.

question: How many Toyotas roll off production lines every minute?
explainer: Toyota built about 10.3 million vehicles in 2023. A year has 525,960 minutes, so about 20 Toyotas a minute.
